issues: The characters field lists wives and children as present, but the verse only says the survivors returned to them; their physical presence in the scene is not explicit.
The character label “Nephite women and children” may imply they are present, but their deaths are reported aftermath; do not depict them as living participants.
Verse 5 says the Lamanites were “naked, save it were skin which was girded about their loins”; armor and weapons are also described. The explicit-facts summary should preserve this qualification.

Verse 6 explicitly describes the Lamanites’ skins as dark; the summary of distinguishing appearance omits this stated detail, though its prohibition on assigning skin color to present-day groups is appropriate.

The summary says the Amlicites marked themselves, but verse 18 does not specify when that occurred; the preceding scene already presents the marking at verse 13. Keep this scene as narration about their rebellion and the consequence, not a new marking action.
The label “Mormon (narrator, identified by the supplied context)” is unsupported: no supplied verse identifies Mormon as narrator.
